name: Jacqueline Cochran Regional Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 17/35, is 8,500 ft x 150 ft (about 2,591 m x 46 m); crosswind 12/30 is 4,995 ft x 100 ft
runway.quote: RWY 17/35 which is 8,500 ft. long, 150 ft. wide.

fuel.v: Jet A and Avgas through the FBOs
fuel.quote: You can get fuel (Jet A & AVGAS) through our FBO's.

handling.v: FBOs named by the county: Atlantic Aviation North, Atlantic Aviation South, Desert Jet Center, Thermal Aviation; contact them for operating hours

notes: Facts from the Riverside County airport page for TRM (undated). The county's 2024 RFP (ktrm-rc-rfp-2024) gives the same runway sizes, says the airport is Class E airspace on CTAF/UNICOM (accepted into the FAA Contract Tower Program) and mentions CBP service only 'if Customs and Border Protection (CBP) service is approved', so customs at TRM is not confirmed: treat as no customs until checked. No noise rules or curfew found on county pages. No FAA airport diagram for TRM found; FAA Chart Supplement could not be opened.
